description: Self-hosted API-first AI call center: AI talks, code controls the call. AI agents answer every call; humans take over without dropping it. Runs on FreeSWITCH with your SIP trunk and realtime model (OpenAI, Grok, Qwen, Doubao, or any compatible gateway).
summary: Self-hosted, API-first AI call center. Realtime voice bots answer every call, human agents take over without a drop. Full REST + SSE API with OpenAPI spec to embed in your product. FreeSWITCH + OpenAI Realtime / Qwen, one Go binary.
